negative_cases.name: user_object_modified
negative_cases.scenario: User object attribute modified outside the policies container.
negative_cases.rationale: The policy container selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: policy_value_deleted
negative_cases.scenario: Value removed from a policy object.
negative_cases.rationale: The operation type selection does not match a deletion.

negative_cases.name: policy_object_read
negative_cases.scenario: Policy object read during a configuration report.
negative_cases.rationale: The event identifier selection does not match a read operation.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
